strengths.item: The paper is well organized, with a clear progression from motivation and contributions, to background notation, generic IMEC, ARIMEC, experiments, and appendices.
The Introduction explicitly lists the main contributions, making the paper’s goals easy to identify early.

Definitions, algorithms, and propositions are generally placed near the relevant explanatory text; Algorithms 1--3 and the main propositions are visually legible and help structure the technical presentation.
Figures and captions are mostly useful and inspectable: Figures 1--4 are generally legible, and captions connect the visuals to the method or experimental setting.

weaknesses.item: Large portions of prose and technical text appear in bright blue across multiple pages, which is visually distracting and gives the paper an unpolished or draft-like appearance.
Some pages are visually crowded, especially page 7 with multiple figures, text, a proposition, and a section heading.
Some figure details are small, particularly notation in Figure 2 and tick labels/legend elements in Figure 3, which may make inspection harder in print or at reduced zoom.
The technical terminology is dense: the reader must track many related objects such as partitions, block functions, prefix-tree partitions, posterior block entropy, IMEC, FIMEC, TIMEC, and ARIMEC.

dimension_review.evidence_summary: The PDF inspection found a generally readable ICLR-style layout with clear section hierarchy, legible algorithms, readable equations, and mostly informative captions. Figure 1, Figure 2, Figure 3, and Figure 4 were judged mostly legible, though some labels and notation are small and page 7 is crowded. The main visual concern is extensive bright-blue text on pages 1 and 3--7. Text-level inspection found that Section 1 clearly states the contributions; Section 2 introduces definitions before algorithms; Section 3 presents the generic IMEC framework and propositions coherently; Section 4 defines ARIMEC and discusses runtime/implementation; and Section 5 separates the experimental narrative into Markov coding games and steganography.
dimension_review.rationale: The presentation is good overall: the paper is understandable, logically structured, and mostly easy to inspect, with clear algorithms, definitions, and a coherent experimental narrative. However, notable formatting and visual polish issues—especially the pervasive blue text, crowded figure layout, small figure details, and dense terminology—prevent an excellent score. These issues affect ease of review but do not make the paper hard to understand, so a score of 3 is appropriate.
